paragraphs: Rav Yeiva bar Yosi. [He reported:] “Rav said” — Arakhin 5b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Arakhin 5b in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic has רַב יֵיבָא בַּר יוֹסֵי אָמַר רַב, explicitly giving Rav Yeiva bar Yosi reporting in Rav’s name. This supports the expanded title and the bracketed reporting gloss in this notice.
ה:. is read as the folio 5b marker followed by a terminal period. Hyman supplies only the attribution and citation here, without the reported statement’s content.
